integration_issues.issue: The 'Credit specials' upsell modal (session-scoped) can appear ON TOP of /ai-builder and intercepts clicks on aeb-gate-apply-btn. Workaround: navigate directly to /builder-program or dismiss modal first. Carry-over from iterations 93/94/95/96.

action_items: OPTIONAL (carry-over from iter 93-96): persist a session-scoped dismiss for the 'Credit specials' modal + 'AI CMO cross-sell' card on /ai-builder so it doesn't intercept clicks on aeb-gate-apply-btn (already noted in iteration_96.json).

OPTIONAL: mobile /builder-program 'Tell us about you' section — the free-text areas (motivation/value/ideas) are hard to distinguish; consider adding a subtle character counter and section labels above each textarea for clarity on a 390px viewport.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/routes/builder_program.py::builder_access uses current['workspace_id'] to check team-plan; but a user in multi-workspace state may have a different active workspace than the one that owns the team plan — plan lookup is scoped to a single workspace so builder_access via 'team_plan' is only true for the workspace where the user is currently active. That's a reasonable design; document it.

backend/routes/builder_program.py::apply — the duplicate check uses status ∈ {pending, approved}. If a user is rejected then rejected → can they re-apply? Currently YES (rejected is not in the list) — good, but consider adding rate-limit (e.g., 1 re-apply per 30 days) to prevent abuse.

backend/routes/builder_program.py::decide sets user.builder_approved=(status=='approved'). Approving is fine, but if a super admin later flips 'approve' → 'reject' on the SAME application id, this correctly revokes access. However there is no separate 'revoke access without re-decide' endpoint. Also no audit trail for repeated decisions — the row is mutated in place. Consider appending to a decisions history array.

backend/services/billing.py::_unlimited_workspace_ids — now includes ALL workspaces a super_admin is a member of. This is a broad grant; make sure the ledger 'billed_amount' vs 'amount' fields are surfaced in the admin analytics so cost attribution is still visible for super-admin usage in customer workspaces.

frontend/src/pages/ai_builder/AIEmployeeBuilder.jsx::aeb-gate-apply-btn — visible for approved users too when the promo modal overlays; make the gate wrapper have z-index above ephemeral promo modals OR let the promo modal auto-dismiss on route change to /ai-builder.
